About Our Vancouver Office

Located in the heart of downtown Vancouver, between the Pacific Ocean and the Coast Mountains, Teck’s Corporate Office sits in one of Canada’s most culturally diverse cities.

Surrounded by world-renowned nature and globally inspired cuisine, the office brings together many of Teck’s corporate functions - all working toward Teck’s purpose of providing the essential resources the world relies on.

Application Deadline: We will review applications on a rolling-basis 

Duration: 8 months

Positions Available: 1

Start Date: January 4, 2027

For this exciting opportunity, we are seeking students pursuing degrees in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Engineering, Business Administration, Commerce, or related fields. Candidates should be in their third or fourth year of study with prior co-op, internship, or relevant work experience. Preference will be given to master's students. Applicants must be enrolled in a Canadian post-secondary institution for the full duration of the co-op term and be eligible to return to their studies following completion of the work term. A valid study permit and proof of enrollment will be required where applicable.

Ideal candidates will have exposure to Power BI, data visualization, and business intelligence concepts through coursework, projects, co-op placements, or work experience. Familiarity with Power BI Desktop, DAX, Power Query, SQL Server, or Oracle databases is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, along with a basic understanding of data modelling and relational databases, will support success in this role.

Don’t miss out on this opening to be part of one of Canada’s leading mining companies and join our team!

Why consider Teck Resources Limited for your Co-op Placement? 

At Teck, we offer more than just a job – we provide a comprehensive student experience comprised of relevant, hands-on work, vibrant social activities, extensive networking opportunities, and rich professional development. With captivating projects set against stunning backdrops, a culture of inclusivity and collaboration, and boundless opportunities to learn, grow, and have fun, joining us means embracing a fulfilling and dynamic co-op adventure.

- Financial assistance to help with travel costs and co-op fees
- Opportunity to develop technical skills and gain practical experience while applying academic knowledge to real-world mining operations and projects
- Enjoy mentorship and guidance from experienced specialists in their respective fields
- Receive primary consideration for professional positions upon graduation

Key Responsibilities



- Be a courageous safety leader, adhere to and sponsor safety and environmental rules and procedures
- Learn and understand Teck's reporting architecture, data models, data sources, and business processes through structured training and hands-on experience

- Develop new Power BI reports and dashboards to support business and operational requirements
- Write and optimize SQL queries to retrieve, transform, validate, and analyze data from relational databases.
- Develop and maintain data transformations using Power Query / M.
- Develop and maintain DAX measures, calculated columns, and calculations to support reporting requirements
- Apply data modelling principles to create efficient and scalable Power BI semantic models
- Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency
- Solve data, refresh, modelling, and report performance issues
- Work with business analysts and customers to understand reporting requirements and translate them into effective reporting solutions
- Participate in iterative development and feedback cycles, delivering early versions of reports and dynamically improving them based on customer feedback
- Maintain appropriate documentation for reports, data sources, data models, calculations, and reporting processes
- Support deployment, testing, and release of Power BI reports across development, test, and production environments
- Find opportunities to automate manual reporting and improve the efficiency of existing reporting processes
- Follow established data governance, security, access control, and reporting standards

Qualifications



- Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Engineering, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field
- Some experience or academic exposure to Microsoft Power BI, data visualization, or business intelligence
- Basic understanding of SQL and the ability to read, write, and understand simple queries
- Understanding of basic relational database concepts, including tables, fields, keys, and relationships between tables
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in understanding data and identifying trends, patterns, and discrepancies
- Ability to learn new technologies, data models, and business processes through training and hands-on experience
- Ability to work with others to understand business requirements and translate them into practical reporting solutions

Why choose a Co-op with Teck? 

At Teck, we offer more than just a job – we provide a comprehensive student experience comprised of relevant, hands-on work, vibrant social activities, extensive networking opportunities, and rich professional development.

With captivating projects set against stunning backdrops, a culture of inclusivity and collaboration, and boundless opportunities to learn, grow, and have fun, joining us means embracing a fulfilling and dynamic co-op adventure.

Pay Range: CAD $4,108 - $5,183 per month

The actual amount offered is determined based on the successful candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and competencies and considers internal equity.

In addition, our Co-ops receive a variety of advantages including:



- Financial assistance to help with travel costs and co-op fees 
- Opportunity to develop technical skills and gain practical experience while applying academic knowledge to real-world mining operations and projects 
- Enjoy mentorship and guidance from experienced specialists in their respective fields 
- Receive primary consideration for professional positions upon graduation 

Apply with us 

Take the next step in your career by applying for the Power Platform Reporting Co-op role. We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn’t match every requirement. Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

About The Role

As an AI Product Intern, you will work closely with engineers, researchers, and product leaders to help design, build, and deploy AI-powered software solving real-world problems. This is a highly hands-on role where you’ll gain exposure to the full product lifecycle, from understanding customer needs to shipping production-grade AI applications.

You’ll contribute directly to live projects used by governments, healthcare systems, and industrial partners, while learning how cutting-edge AI is turned into real, scalable products.

In This Role, You Will

Build & Ship Real Products: Support the design and development of AI-powered features across front-end, back-end, and data workflows. Help prototype and ship internal tools and customer-facing applications using modern web technologies

Learn Product + Engineering in Practice: Work with product managers and engineers to translate customer problems into clear product requirements. Gain exposure to how AI models are integrated into real-world software systems

Collaborate Closely: Partner with engineers, researchers, and operators to test, iterate, and improve AI-driven workflows. Participate in design discussions, sprint planning, and code reviews

Optimize & Improve: Assist with improving performance, reliability, and usability of deployed applications. Help analyze data, evaluate AI outputs, and iterate based on real customer feedback

Make a Real Impact: Contribute to projects modernizing government workflows, improving healthcare outcomes, or optimizing critical infrastructure. See your work deployed and used by real users — not just internal demos

You Will Thrive If You



- Are a current undergraduate students, specifically juniors and seniors graduating no later than June 2028, pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field
- Have experience with software development fundamentals (through coursework, internships, or personal projects).
- Are familiar with or excited to learn technologies like Python, TypeScript, React, REST APIs, and cloud platforms
- Are curious about AI systems, product thinking, and real-world applications of machine learning
- Enjoy solving ambiguous problems and learning quickly in fast-paced environments
- Communicate clearly, collaborate well, and take ownership of your work
- Are excited to work directly on impactful problems rather than purely theoretical projects

Internship Details & Benefits



- Dates: May 31, 2027 - Aug 6, 2027 or July 5, 2027 - September 10, 2027
- Competitive internship compensation
- Hands-on mentorship from experienced AI engineers and researchers
- Opportunity to work on real production systems used globally
- Potential return-offer consideration for future internships or full-time roles
- Daily lunches (if onsite)
fit_why: Full-stack, Python, React, RAG/OpenAI, production shipping fits well

About The Role

As an AI Security Engineer Intern, you’ll work alongside experienced security, platform, and infrastructure engineers to help build security directly into how Brain Co. develops and ships software.

This co-op is designed for current undergraduate juniors and seniors graduating no later than June 2028 who want hands-on experience securing real production systems. You’ll contribute to projects across CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, containers, and Infrastructure-as-Code while receiving mentorship through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on collaboration with the team.

This is a builder-focused security role. You’ll learn how security tooling and automated guardrails can make the secure path the easy path for engineers.

What You’ll Work On



- Help build and improve security controls in CI/CD pipelines, including static analysis, secrets scanning, dependency checks, and automated policy enforcement.
- Contribute to developer-facing security tooling, such as linting rules, reusable workflows, automation, and guardrails.
- Help secure Kubernetes and containerized workloads, including access controls, image security, workload configuration, and deployment policies.
- Contribute to security baselines in Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code, including IAM, networking, encryption, and secure defaults.
- Work with cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure to identify misconfigurations and improve security visibility.
- Help automate the detection and remediation of common security issues.
- Participate in threat modeling, code reviews, and architecture discussions alongside experienced security and platform engineers.
- Work with engineers to understand security findings and turn them into practical, actionable fixes.
- Help improve documentation and tooling so security controls are easy for developers to understand and adopt.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You…



- Are a current juniors and seniors, graduating no later than June 2028, pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field.
- Have strong software engineering fundamentals through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects.
- Have experience programming in Python, Go, Java, C++, Bash, or a similar language.
- Have exposure to or a strong interest in application security, platform security, cloud security, or infrastructure security.
- Are familiar with or excited to learn technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and AWS/GCP/Azure.
- Have an interest in how software moves from code to production, including CI/CD, containers, cloud infrastructure, and deployment workflows.
- Enjoy thinking about how systems can fail, where trust boundaries exist, and how security controls can prevent problems without slowing engineers down.
- Are curious, proactive, and excited to learn quickly in a fast-paced engineering environment.
- Enjoy taking ownership of technical problems while learning from experienced engineers.

Bonus Points For



- Coursework, projects, or internship experience involving cloud security, Kubernetes, or Infrastructure-as-Code.
- Familiarity with security tooling such as OPA, Conftest, Kyverno, Trivy, Semgrep, or similar tools.
- Experience with secrets management, IAM, or authentication and authorization systems.
- Interest in software supply chain security, including dependency security, image signing, SBOMs, or secure build pipelines.
- Experience building developer tools or automation.

Internship Details & Benefits



- Dates: May 31, 2027 - Aug 6, 2027 or July 5, 2027 - September 10, 2027
- Competitive internship compensation.
- Hands-on mentorship from experienced security and infrastructure engineers.
- Opportunity to work on real production systems used globally.
- Potential return-offer consideration for future internships or full-time roles.
- Daily lunches if onsite.

Micro-Intern: Software Engineer (IAP - Alumni Host)

 Location : On-site; Boston/Cambridge, MA;
 Dates: Full-Time; January 4, 2027 - January 29, 2027
 Compensation : $20-25/hr

 About the Company 

 Cartesian is building spatial intelligence for indoor environments to drive operational efficiency. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in the $35T global retail industry: in-store inventory visibility. Our platform delivers accurate indoor positioning and actionable product location insights, helping retailers streamline operations, optimize workflows, and reduce inefficiencies. Leveraging wireless signals, we provide a uniquely scalable, infrastructure-free solution already deployed by international fashion brands.

 Founded by an MIT engineering professor and alum behind the award-winning, patented core technologies, Cartesian spun out in 2023. Originally backed by the prestigious SBIR Award from the US National Science Foundation, we've bootstrapped to a live product that's now deployed in over a dozen countries and have been aggressively scaling in the market.

 About the Role 

 We are scaling up our platform and developing new features to meet product demand.

 We are looking for a motivated software engineering intern to help us integrate with new customers, improve our core platform, and expand our product capabilities. We are seeking individuals who want to see how to design and develop new technology in a startup environment. You will work alongside senior engineers and ship code to real customers.

 This role is on-site, and our office is right in Kendall Square by the Red Line stop.

 The internship will be full-time. IAP is less than a month, and in order to maximize the value of the internship for you and Cartesian, it requires a full-time focus. If you have other commitments over IAP (e.g. clubs or classes), it probably won’t be a good fit.

 What You’ll Do 

 At the beginning of IAP, we will define a specific project you will have ownership and responsibility for during internship duration. You will be learning extremely fast, providing clarity to ambiguity, and iterating on feedback each week.

 Potential projects include:

• Customer Expansion: Developing robust interfaces for data and users with international retail brands. 

• Platform: Modernizing our stack to Infrastructure-as-Code and upgrading our core Postgres platform for performance and resilience.  

• Research Tooling: Work closely with research teams to build infrastructure for machine-learning development and collecting fast, accurate edge-device sensor data. 

• Security and Tooling: Implementing a new system for enforcing short-lived machine-to-machine credentials, hardening our identity-and-access approach, and automating key rotation. 

• UI/UX: Making user interactions between our product and the physical world more seamless, ergonomic, and beautiful.  

• Optimization: Instrument and measure our cloud platform costs to optimize infrastructure, application, and development efficiency. 

• Testing: Build full-stack test infrastructure across physical devices, mobile, and backend to maintain our bar for high quality and accelerate development. 

 These are just examples, and we will work closely with you to design a project that is important for the company and matches your interests. Please come prepared to your interview with an idea of the type of work you are looking to do over IAP.

 About You 

• High Growth : You're curious and learn fast. You'd rather dig into something unfamiliar than stay in your comfort zone. 

• High Ownership: Given a task, you break it down with minimal oversight and make sure it gets done – even when it's ambiguous, or the last bit gets messy. 

• Low Ego : You don’t know everything. You want the best ideas to win. Nothing is below you. 

• Strong Coder: You write clean, working code without heavy hand-holding, and you can explain the "why" behind your choices, not just show the result. You’ve worked in large codebases on a team before. 
 
 Why Now? 

 We’re a fast-moving MIT startup at an important inflection point for our product growth and direction. We are building a talent-dense team of engineers and applied researchers to solve hard, high-impact problems in retail operations.

 The IAP internship is a great way to see the inner workings of a company going from an initial product to a broadly scaled platform across many customers. You will be able to shape real product and platform decisions.

 Technology Stack 

• Backend: FastAPI, Python, Hatchet 

• Mobile: Android, Kotlin 

• Hardware: RFID & Barcode Readers (e.g. Zebra) 

• Data: Postgres, Blob Storage, Parquet 

• Infrastructure: Azure, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform 

• Machine Learning: PyTorch, Ray 

• Frontend: Next.js, Typescript, Tailwind 
 
 Interview Process 

• Application (30 minutes) : Answer the logistical and interest questions. 

• Interview (60 minutes) : Show us something cool you’ve built. Explain your decisions and what you learned. Ask any questions about the role or company. 

• Offer 
 
 Note: We’ve received a large number of applications for this internship in the past. We try our best to review everyone, but sometimes you may not hear back.
fit_why: Full-stack/backend fit, but Kotlin/Android, hardware and embedded-adjacent work
